patch_description: The prior program plateaus at a local optimum via softmin gradient ascent. Following the recommendation, I add a two-phase optimizer: (1) a global "move all points" coarse phase using random coordinated displacements (σ≈0.01–0.02, re-clipped to the triangle), and (2) a fine single-point pattern search over 12 directions with shrinking steps. This is wrapped in a multi-start loop over several deterministic seeds to escape different local basins, always keeping the best configuration found by exact min-triangle-area evaluation. All randomness is seeded for determinism, and a fallback feasible configuration guards against failures.
